destiny_baseline.limitations: Item rows are the 300s proxy first record among 3081 holders; the base is all valid matches (240s) of the hero.
destiny_baseline.source: heroes.json games/wins of the same hero, same base as the augment deltas on the offer cards

limitations: SUMMARY record positions are not independently verified purchase timestamps.
Destiny candidate pool remains the original at-most-three top-usage candidates; ranking is within that pool.
Binding and undo remain unverified; missing first records are excluded from baseline.

excluded_augments.3176: 五杀摇滚通用记录标记，不是常规可选强化

item_stats_rule: 10人完整5胜5负GameComplete，时长>=300秒；终局装备全槽去重持有，常出榜只交冻结分组内传说成装，排除出门装、组件、鞋子及本轮不推荐ID；鞋子独立栏目。原始装备研究表不删。不表示购买顺序或全局最优出装。
limitations: 只统计已采集到的对局，不是全服数据；七区直接合并。
海克斯按终局全槽去重持有统计；关联不等于因果。
开发候选，最终截止重跑后才能发布。
命运之武器装备建议独立评审，不包含在此公开候选中。

matches.validity_rule: 16.22、队列2400、入库时间早于截止；时长至少240秒、GameComplete、10人完整且5胜5负
